evidence.excerpt: Hadžić is particularly interested in partnerships with NTP Novi Sad companies that deal with custom or project-based manufacturing, software for production management, or supply chain analytics. He prefers collaborations with a clear data-sharing component and is open to co-developing IP if a project has commercial potential.
